value.body: Under the National Health Mission (NHM), state and district health societies hire non-clinical staff to run hospitals and health programmes — hospital managers, district and block programme managers, accounts managers, and data and monitoring staff. Most of these posts are contractual and are advertised by each state's health society.

items.label: Employer type
items.value: State and district health societies under NHM

items.label: Usual qualification for manager posts
items.value: MBA/PGDM in hospital or health management, MHA or MPH
items.note: Some support posts (accounts, data, office) accept graduates

value.title: How you get in
value.body: For hospital-manager and programme-manager posts, the usual route is a BBA or other degree, then an MHA, MBA (Healthcare) or MPH, sometimes with hospital experience. Each state's health society publishes its own notice with eligibility, age limit and selection — usually a written test, interview or merit list.

value.title: At a glance
items: Eligibility, pay and experience requirements differ from state to state and notice to notice.
Most posts are contracts that are renewed periodically, not permanent government jobs.
Postings can be in district hospitals or block-level offices, often outside big cities.
